column1: # Entries for the names matcher fixtures (0.7 task 0.2). Frozen after gate G3.
# Values come from docs/PLAN-0.7.md (Q22-Q29) and docs/ROADMAP-universe.md 1.2, not from any code.
# Columns, tab separated: id, name, aliases, kind, options.
#   id       a slug; the "entry" column of the expected files uses it.
#   name     the entry note basename (the explicit name term).
#   kind     character, place, object, group or event. Only character can give a first-name alias (Q29).
#   options  key=value separated by ;. Keys: lang (pt or en, required), scope (names separated by |,
#            default base), caseSensitive (true), firstName (false), ignore (phrases separated by |).
# A fixture file loads the entries of the scopes named in its #scope line in the expected file
# (default base) whose lang matches the file prefix.
